rows.response_text: To cut and save fresh mint, snip off the bases of the stems and remove any discolored or wilted leaves. Place the mint leaves in a jar or tall plastic container with roughly 1 inch of water, enough to cover the cut stem ends. Let most of the mint leaves stick out of the container like flowers in a vase. Cover the container loosely with a plastic bag and place it in the refrigerator. The mint can be kept for seven to 10 days. Alternatively, the mint can be kept in a jar of water on the kitchen counter, but it may not stay as crisp for as long.
